title: Weather Unhinged
description: Embark on a thrilling journey with the "Weather Unhinged" data pack, an immersive addition to your Minecraft experience that introduces extreme weather conditions to the blocky world.
body:
Embark on a thrilling journey with the "Weather Unhinged" data pack, an immersive addition to your Minecraft experience that introduces extreme weather conditions to the blocky world. Brace yourself as the environment transforms dynamically, presenting new challenges and opportunities for survival. Key Features includes:
  • Earthquakes: Experience the ground shaking beneath your feet as earthquakes add a seismic element to your world. Structures may tremble, and the landscape can change as the earth shifts. If no players are near (175 blocks away), earthquakes won't cause damage to the world.
  • Meter Showers: Witness breathtaking meteor showers as celestial debris streaks across the night sky. Enjoy the visual spectacle, but beware, during these showers, the chance of a meteor impact on the ground increases to a hundred! If no players are near the meteor strikes (100 blocks away), meteors won't cause damage to the world.
NOTE: This data pack CAN be laggy and destructive at times, do NOT install it if you do not wish to put in danger any builds you want to preserve in your world.
